The competition began on 4 November 2011, and ended on 30 September 2012. The defending champions from the [[2010–11 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|previous season]] are [[Espérance de Tunis]]. This is the first full season held after the [[Tunisian Revolution]]. ==Team movements== ===Teams promoted from [[2010–11 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2|CPL-2]]=== *[[Union Sportive Monastir|US
